resolution.name: MPD PSD-MOD 皮秒延时模块
resolution.description: 用于触发/脉冲时序整形的皮秒延时模块，可相对输入沿生成可编程延时与脉宽的 TTL/NIM 输出，适用于高时间分辨实验。
resolution.description_en: A picosecond delay module for trigger and pulse timing shaping, generating programmable-delay and programmable-width TTL/NIM outputs relative to an input edge for high time-resolution experiments.
